blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A blind item has shed light on what allegedly happened behind the scenes of “Celeste Unscripted” and the parts of former couple Celeste Cortesi and Jonathan Sterling’s relationship that did not make it to the show’s season finale. According to the item, Sterling attempted to propose to Cortesi twice — first during their trip to the Maldives and later in Amanpulo. The Maldives proposal was allegedly canceled following a physical incident that reportedly happened about a week before the trip. The account further claims that the alleged abuse was not an isolated incident and continued throughout their relationship. […]...
